purpose: Map user-visible operational risks to bounded Lean theorems and executable runtime evidence without treating formal proof as runtime authority.

title.ja: Human Gate から直接 dispatch できない

risk.en: A pending human decision is mistaken for execution authority.
risk.ja: 人間の判断待ち状態が実行権限として扱われる。

model_scope.en: Direct transitions in the bounded RPOS v0.1 state model.
model_scope.ja: 限定された RPOS v0.1 state model の direct transition。

proof_ceiling.en: Does not prove the legitimacy of a human approval or every runtime admission check.
proof_ceiling.ja: 人間の承認自体の正当性や、すべての runtime admission check は証明しない。

title.ja: VERIFIED のみが COMPLETED へ入れる

risk.en: Transport success or an intermediate state is reported as completed work.
risk.ja: transport success や中間状態が完了済みとして報告される。

model_scope.en: Direct completion transition in the bounded state model.
model_scope.ja: 限定 state model における direct completion transition。

proof_ceiling.en: Does not prove that arbitrary readback evidence is truthful or sufficient.
proof_ceiling.ja: 任意の readback evidence が真実または十分であることは証明しない。

title.ja: EFFECT_UNKNOWN は COMPLETED ではない

risk.en: An ambiguous external effect is collapsed into false success.
risk.ja: 曖昧な external effect が偽の成功へ潰される。

model_scope.en: State distinction plus executable uncertainty-preservation behavior.
model_scope.ja: state の区別と executable な uncertainty-preservation behavior。

proof_ceiling.en: Does not decide what the external system actually did; it preserves that uncertainty.
proof_ceiling.ja: external system が実際に何をしたかを決定せず、その不確実性を保持する。

title.ja: READY_TO_RESUME は実行権限ではない

risk.en: Repair readiness silently restores permission to execute.
risk.ja: repair readiness が暗黙に実行権限を復元する。

model_scope.en: State separation between repair readiness and authorization.
model_scope.ja: repair readiness と authorization の state separation。

proof_ceiling.en: Does not prove the correctness of the repair or the legitimacy of renewed authority.
proof_ceiling.ja: repair の正しさや renewed authority の正当性は証明しない。

title.en: A receipt is not external-effect verification
title.ja: receipt は external-effect verification ではない

risk.en: An API or transport acknowledgement is treated as proof of real-world effect.
risk.ja: API / transport acknowledgement が現実の作用の証明として扱われる。

model_scope.en: Bounded classification of operational evidence sources.
model_scope.ja: operational evidence source の限定 classification。

proof_ceiling.en: Does not prove an external observation itself is correct; concrete verification remains adapter/evidence work.
proof_ceiling.ja: external observation 自体の正しさは証明せず、具体的 verification は adapter/evidence 側に残る。

title.en: A model proposal is not operational authority
title.ja: model proposal は Operational Authority ではない

risk.en: Model confidence or intent is allowed to become authority by implication.
risk.ja: model の confidence や intent が暗黙に authority へ昇格する。

model_scope.en: Bounded classification of model proposals versus human authorization.
model_scope.ja: model proposal と human authorization の限定 classification。

proof_ceiling.en: Does not evaluate model quality or define every deployment-specific authority rule.
proof_ceiling.ja: model quality や deployment 固有の全 authority rule は評価・定義しない。
